clusters.label: Release diagnosis and verification overhead
clusters.definition: Repeated manual work required to diagnose releases, compare environments, verify recovery, and assemble sign-off evidence.

clusters.label: Research synthesis fragmentation
clusters.definition: Repeated manual consolidation, tagging, traceability, and reshaping of interview research.

clusters.label: Subscription reconciliation exceptions
clusters.definition: Manual investigation and reconciliation of invoice, plan-change, credit, and renewal exceptions.

clusters.label: Incident handoff context loss
clusters.definition: Missing timeline, ownership, impact, and diagnostic context when incident responsibility changes.

clusters.label: Vendor questionnaire repetition
clusters.definition: Repeated preparation, evidence retrieval, assignment, and freshness checking for vendor reviews.

clusters.label: Inventory exception triage
clusters.definition: Manual collection, prioritization, context gathering, and closure of inventory exceptions.

clusters.label: Compliance evidence collection
clusters.definition: Repeated and late collection, dating, deduplication, and tracking of audit evidence.

clusters.label: Support escalation context assembly
clusters.definition: Manual preparation and reuse of symptoms, prior actions, outcomes, and escalation-readiness context.
